name: Last Arrow Manufacturing
old_description: Last Arrow Manufacturing LLC, based in Orrville, Ohio, is a premier precision Sheet Metal fabrication shop and manufacturer. We take pride in offering comprehensive services and solutions to our valued customers. With a dedicated team of over 120 skilled professionals, we operate from two well-equipped facilities. Our wide range of capabilities includes Engineering, 3D Design, and advanced manufacturing processes featuring 3 Fiber Lasers, 8 Hydraulic Press Brakes, Robotic Welding utilizing 12 FANUC Welding Cobots, as well as 35 Manual Weld Stations, CNC Machining, Manual Mills, Lathes, and Drill Presses. At Last Arrow Manufacturing, we are committed to delivering top-notch craftsmanship and exceeding customer expectations.
about:
Last Arrow Manufacturing LLC operates from two facilities in Orrville, Ohio. The company employs over 120 skilled professionals and specializes in precision sheet metal fabrication, welding, CNC machining, and operator cab design and build.

The shop runs three fiber lasers (including 12 kW Trumpf and LVD systems), eight hydraulic press brakes up to 350 tons, twelve FANUC robotic welding cobots, and 35 manual weld stations. CNC capabilities include Haas lathes with live tooling, multiple vertical machining centers, and a Mazak 510C. The company also maintains manual mills, lathes, drill presses, and an in-house powder coating line. Engineering and 3D design services support custom projects from concept through production.

Last Arrow serves customers in transportation, forestry, mining, firefighting, handicapped-accessible vehicles, medical equipment, large hydraulic trash pumps, and oil and gas services. A core focus is designing and building operator cabs for mobile equipment, using internal fixturing and machining fixtures to ensure repeatable precision.

The company emphasizes vertical integration, constructing its own weld and machining fixtures to control quality and lead times. Investment in fiber laser and robotic welding technology is driven by a diverse customer base that pushes continuous capability expansion. Certified AWS D1.1, D1.4, and 6G welders support structural and pressure-vessel work.
